subtitle.en: Inspect an indexed conveyor. Route pass and rework parts.
subtitle.zh: 检查步进输送线，将合格品与返工件分流。

description.en: A production-line app for small component manufacturers. The conveyor advances machined housings into a wrist-camera inspection station. The app checks the visible finish marker, then moves each housing into the pass or rework lane. Sold by an example automation publisher through the app store.
description.zh: 面向小型零部件厂商的产线应用。输送线将加工壳体送入腕部摄像头检查工位，应用检查可见的表面标记，再把每件壳体分到合格或返工通道。演示自动化开发者通过应用商店销售此应用。

label.en: Inspect using the simulated wrist camera
label.zh: 通过模拟腕部摄像头检查

origin.en: Example commercial app · simulated finish classification and indexed belt. A demo purchase unlocks both arm profiles; no payment is collected.
origin.zh: 示例商业应用 · 模拟表面分类与步进输送。演示购买后适用于两种机械臂，不收取实际费用。

description.en: Scan six housings; separate pass and rework parts.
description.zh: 检查六件壳体，分开合格品和返工件。

description.en: Run the line with a freshly generated batch.
description.zh: 生成新批次，再次运行质检线。
